workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: Professional personnel employed for ten months may be scheduled to work 192 days in the school year.

workload_workday_length_002.evidence: The normal work day for professional personnel employed for ten months shall be 7 1/2 hours inclusive of lunch time.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: Teacher planning time will be scheduled in accordance with the following procedures:

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Secondary: 45 minutes daily. Elementary/Special Ed: 225 minutes per week plus 30 minutes daily during student lunch/recess.
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: The Principal shall schedule a continuous block of forty-five minutes daily of planning time during the work day of 7 1/2 hours for each teacher. ... The Principal shall schedule 225 minutes of planning time for each teacher per regular work week of five normal work days. In addition ... a block of thirty (30) minutes ... of daily uninterrupted planning time during student lunch and recess periods for each elementary teacher.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: Except for the lunch period, any non-teaching time of a teacher shall be devoted to professional activities such as planning the instructional program... teachers will be responsible for determining the use of their planning time

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: Each professional person shall be provided a lunch period free of duty each regularly scheduled school day as established by Maryland School Law.
